info.name: Deferendum
info.summary: Understand and participate in community decisions
info.description: A read-only Dashboard and a mobile-first glass workspace for selected Deferendum groups, with a guide, searchable help and explicit action previews. Optional explicit permissions enable discussion reading and participation: concerns and urgency ratings, arguments and reactions, wording proposals and support, governing rules and voting. Each member connects separately; existing read-only grants are never upgraded automatically. Actions require confirmation and source role, phase and version checks. Connect an existing Deferendum account from a compatible public HTTPS Nextcloud instance. Each user selects accessible groups and separately authorizes optional discussion and participation permissions. No persistent private-content cache or default telemetry is maintained. The hosted service and the Nextcloud administrator remain separate trust boundaries.
info.author: Nick Dragoi
